business_problem: Ocean Network Express (ONE) replaced fragmented legacy BI with a unified Looker and BigQuery data platform. Using Looker's semantic layer and a 'Hub and Spoke' model, ONE established global KPIs and is preparing for AI-driven conversational analytics.
solution_summary: Ocean Network Express (ONE) replaced fragmented legacy BI with a unified Looker and BigQuery data platform. Using Looker's semantic layer and a 'Hub and Spoke' model, ONE established global KPIs and is preparing for AI-driven conversational analytics. Alongside this on-premise solution, other BI tools were being used on siloed data, leading to a lack of governance where different teams would generate conflicting reports-comparing "apples to oranges" rather than operating from a shared reality. To resolve this, ONE initiated one of the most extensive evaluation processes in Looker's history. An evaluation committee composed of cross-regional stakeholders was formed to ensure a unified decision. The team conducted a rigorous "bake-off," building identical proofs of concept in both Looker and shortlisted BI tools to test real-world implementation.
